zones.name: demo_floor
zones._comment: Whole frame at 1080p, so 'entered' = came into view. entry_confirm_seconds: a person must be seen inside this long before ENTERED fires (a single false box cannot). lost_grace_seconds: a track that vanishes in the middle of the floor (turned away from the webcam, occluded, detector dropout) is not someone who LEFT — it stays present this long and a re-detection at the spot inherits it; only a track last seen at the frame edge leaves after the ordinary grace. To make 'entered the room' mean a doorway, draw the polygon over the door in 0..1 frame fractions, e.g. [[0.35,0.2],[0.65,0.2],[0.65,1.0],[0.35,1.0]].
